Sammadatthamabhiññāya, maccudheyyapahāyino;Sabbadukkhoghanittiṇṇā, pāraṃ gacchanti paṇḍitā
Iti sabbaṅgasampannaṃ, mahesigaṇasevitaṃ;Nekkhammaṃ kāmanikkhantaṃ, saddhammapathamuttamaṃ
Virādhenti parābhūtā, mucchitā yena dujjanā;Taṃ pāpasamudācāraṃ, pariyuṭṭhānamabravuṃ.
Sabbāsavamalopeto, sabbopaklesasañcayo;Pāpayakkhasamo ceso, dosāsīvisasaṅgamo.
Pamādapathamakkantaṃ, amittagaṇasaṅgamaṃ;Mahabbhayasamuṭṭhānaṃ, mahābyasanasaṅkaraṃ.
Dhiratthu pāpadhammānaṃ, sabbakalyāṇahāyinaṃ;Laddhāpi khaṇasampatti, dullabhā yehi nāsitā.
Tesaṃ hi samudācāro, dullabhaṃ buddhasāsanaṃ;Samuddhaṃseti asani, yathā ratanapabbataṃ.
Vissāsivadhakāpete, vissaṭṭhāvassaghātino;Yehi bālāhatā senti, nissayejinasāsane.
Tepi vāsenti dummedhā, nissaṅkā mohapārutā;Antomanasi ucchaṅke, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā.
Halāhalaṃva khādantā, āliṅgantāva pāpakaṃ;Avassamupahaññanti, pāpadhammopalāḷino.
Pāpacintā paribyuḷhā, vitakkamathitā janā;Lokadvayāpi dhaṃsenti, atthadvayavināsino.
Kodhūpanāhi vigacchā, issāmaccheradūsitā;Makkhī palāsī sārambhī, appatissā agāravā.
Mānātimānabahulā, mudhāmukharacaṇḍikā;Uddhatā ca pamattā ca, dabbitā ketugāhino.
Cetokhilakhilabhūtā, vinibandhānuveṭhitā;Mahogho viya sassāni, vināsenti tapoguṇaṃ.
Visayassādavikkhittā, vikiṇṇā pākatindriyā;Muṭṭhassatī kusītā ca, jīvanti moghajīvitaṃ.
Mahagghasā bāhulikā, duppaññā kāyadaḷhikā;Ganthanīvaraṇābaddhā, icchālobhavasīkatā.
Malaggahitasantānā, tiracchānakathāratā;Vinayopasamāpetā, visamācāragocarā.
Dubbharatā ca dupposā, sukumārasukhālayā;Asantuṭṭhā mahicchā ca, loluppācāralakkhitā.
Duggandheneva sunakhā, āmagandhena mucchitā;Tattha tatthābhidhāvantā, na patiṭṭhanti sāsan
Nillajjā vītasārajjā, lokadhammesu mucchitā;Pāpicchā kuhanacchannā, micchājīvapalobhitā.
Saṭhā pagabbhā māyāvī, antopūti avassutā;Saṅkassarasamācārā, kasambu sithilā jaḷā.
Siṅgāracapalācittā, pūtikāyānurāgino;Sīdantā palimāpannā, na viruḷhanti sāsane.
Pāpapuggalasaṃsaṭṭhā, pāpadiṭṭhiparāgatā;Asaddhā dhammanicchinnā, duṭṭhā dubbacaniṭṭhurā.
Sāmaññaṃ paridhaṃsentā, dūsentā jinasāsanaṃ;Atikkamma jinovādaṃ, bālā duggatibhāgino.
Kāmagiddhā durācārā, dussīlā mohapārutā;Khajjantā kaddamībhūtā, jinasāsanakaṇṭakā.
Vipannākulakammantā, pāpakārī parājitā;Socanti dīghamaddhānaṃ, apāyamhi samappitā.
Itthaṃ hitasamucchedī, kumaggoyaṃ rajāpatho;Pāpadhammappavattīti, viditvā puna paṇḍito.
Pariyuṭṭhānasaṃklesaṃ, vippharantaṃ visārado;Paṭisaṅkhāya rundheyya, manteneva mahāvisaṃ.
Appamādena medhāvī, nageneva mahānadiṃ;Pāpoghaṃ paṭibandhanto, pidaheyya khaṇe khaṇe.
Sabhayaṃ viya kantāraṃ, ghoramāsīvisaṃ yathā;Papātamiva gambhīraṃ, miḷhaṃ viya ca paṇḍito.
Sorato sakhilo saṇho, mettāyanto dayāparo;Anāhaṭamano dhīro, santacitto khamāparo.
Okappento vimuccanto, paññavā paṭipattiyaṃ;Pihayanto mamāyanto, sammāsambuddhasāsanaṃ.
Hirottappaguṇopeto,Kalyāṇācāragocaro;Makkhappalāsarahito,Sappatisso sagāravo.
Ajjavācāracāritto, māyāsāṭheyyanissaṭo;Thambhasārambhanissaṅgo, maddavācārapesalo.
Mānātimānavimukho, saddhammagarusādaro;Parappamādanimmaddī, saṃvegabahulo sadā.
Vodātacittasaṅkappo, pāpicchāmalavajjito;Micchādiṭṭhimatikkanto, saddhammesu patiṭṭhito.
Pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho, santo appicchatārato;Ariyāvaṃsālaṅkāro, supposo subharo sukhī.
Sallekhavutti dhutavā, pāpāpacayatapparo;Pāsādikasamācāro, pasādabahulo muni.
Cetokāḷakāpagato, bhāvanārasamuttamaṃ;Raṅgaṃ niddhotavatthaṃva, sādhukaṃ paṭigaṇhati.
Iti sampāditākāro, parisuddhamanoratho;Nirādīnavasañcāro, sotthipatto niraṅgaṇo.
Iccālobhamadosañca, mohābhāvamathāparaṃ;Nekkhammaṃ pavivekañca, tathā nissaraṇaṃ budho.
Pathavīkasiṇaṃ tāva, vidatthicaturaṅgulaṃ;Katvānāruṇavaṇṇāya, mattikāya sumaṇḍalaṃ.
Yugamatte ṭhapetvāna, ṭhāne sukhanisinnako;Pathavīti samaññāya, katvābhogaṃ tu bhāvaye.
Akatepi khalādimhi, akiccheneva maṇḍale;Nimittaṃ jāyaticcāhu, pubbayogavato pana.
Tattha paṇṇattisaṅkhāte, nimitte bhāvanāmaye;Tatheva paṭibhāgamhi, tato yuñjeyya bhāvanaṃ.
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti samma vaṇṇitā.
Ekaṅguladvaṅgulādi-vaseneva yathākkamaṃ;Pharanto manasāyeva, nipuṇo yāvadicchakaṃ.
Tatthevaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ, patvāna paguṇaṃ tato;Katvā ciṇṇavasībhūtā, tamhā vuṭṭhāya paṇḍit
Ekāhādimatikkantaṃ, uddhumātakamīritaṃ;Vigatacchavi bībhacchaṃ, nīlākāraṃ vinīlakaṃ.
Vikiṇṇapubbakudhitaṃ, paribhinnaṃ vipubbakaṃ;Viccheditaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ, vicchiddakaṃ kaḷevara
Vividhākārapāṇehi, khajjamānaṃ vikhāditaṃ;Vināsitaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ, vikkhittanti pavuccati.
Pādādibhaṅgavikkhittaṃ, hatavikkhittakaṃ mataṃ;Lohitaṃ lohitākiṇṇaṃ, puḷavaṃ kimisaṅkulaṃ.
Tatthevaṃ dasadhā bhede, nijjīvakuṇapāsubhe;Ujjhite bhūmibhāgasmiṃ, matakāye kaḷevare.
Labbhamānakamākāraṃ, oloketvā salakkhaṇaṃ;Uggahetvāna cittena, taṃtaṃnāmena bhāvaye.
Paṭikūlañca jegucchaṃ, duggandhañca virūpakaṃ;Harāyitamajaññañca, hīḷitaṃ vikkhitāsivaṃ.
Iccevamasubhākāre,Katvābhogaṃ tu yogino;Bhāventassupacāro ca,Paṭibhāgo ca jāyati.
Paṭibhāganimittaṃ tu, upacārena sevato;Appeti paṭhamajjhāna-metthevaṃ samathe nayo.
Bhāvanaṃ duvidhampetaṃ, bhāventi puna paṇḍitā;Jīvamānepi kāyamhi, taṃtadākārasambhave.
Bahi maṭṭhamupaṭṭhāti, anto kuṇapapūritaṃ;Uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, navadvāramalassavaṃ.
Sarīraṃ niccaduggandhaṃ, nānākimisamākulaṃ;Tacamaṃsapaṭicchannaṃ, aṭṭhipañjarasaṇṭhitaṃ.
Nānābyādhisamākiṇṇaṃ, nānopaddavasaṃkulaṃ;Nānānatthasamodhānaṃ, nānāsaṃklesavatthukaṃ.
Positampi ciraṃ kālaṃ, mamaṃkāramamāyitaṃ;Lahudujjanamittova, pīḷitaṃ sampadussati.
Parihāyati nissāraṃ, jaratāpi taṃ yobbanaṃ;Maccubhajjitamaccanta-masesaṃ paribhijjati.
Tathāpi jālasantāno, bahusambhārasaṅkhato;Vatthālaṅkārasañchanno, mālāgandhādisobhito.
Saviññattivikārehi, vicittākāramaṇḍito;Kāyo līḷavilāsehi, palambheti mahājanaṃ.
Vañcitā yena dummedhā, kāmaklesamalīmayā;Pūrenti caturāpāyaṃ, māradheyyānusārino.
Evamādīnavaṃ ñatvā, pūtikāye vicakkhaṇā;Asubhādikamākāra-mārabbha chandupaṭṭhahuṃ.
Yasmiṃ patanti kuṇape viparītasaññā,Saṃklesapāpavasagā visamaṃ carantā;Taṃ passathetamasub
Jeṭṭho sammābhisambuddho, seṭṭho purisasārathī;Satthā devamanussānaṃ, buddho appaṭipuggalo
Sabbalokahito bandhu, samattaratanālayo;Sattānamanukampāya, jāto nātho sivaṃkaro.
Cakkhumā titthakusalo, dhammassāmī tathāgato;Maccudheyyavimokkhāya, paṭipādayi pāṇino.
Satthavāho mahāyoggo, maggāmaggayudhandharo;Sirisatthamadhiggayha, vicarittha mahāpathaṃ,
Anomo asamo dhīro,Lokahītaparakkamo;Sabbākāravaropeto,Accherabbhutapuggalo.
Atthabhūto dhammabhūto,Brahmabhūto mahāyaso;Ñāṇālokaparicchinna-Ñeyyāsesapariggaho.
Ānubhāvavasippatto, āsabhaṇḍānaniccalo;Mahantamariyādoyamanantagatigocaro.
Appameyyo mahānāgo, mahāvīro mahāmuni;Mahesī mahitācāro, mahāmaho mahiddhiko.
Sabbatthasiddhisañcāro, mahesīgaṇapūjito;Rājādhirājamahito, devabrahmābhivandito.
Abhibhūya tayo loke, ādiccova nabhantare;Virocati mahātejo, andhakāre pabhaṅkaro.
Byāmappabhāparikkhitto, ketumālāhalaṅkato;Dvattiṃsalakkhaṇāsītianubyañjanasobhito.
Satthukappamahāvīraputtehi parivārito;Sabbalokamahiddhāya, dhammarājā sayaṃvasī.
Niddhotamalacandova, nakkhattaparivārito;Khattasaṅghaparibyuḷho, cakkavattīva sobhati.
Iccānantaguṇākiṇṇamasesamalanissaṭaṃ;Sabbasampattidātāraṃ, vipattivinibandhakaṃ.
Taṇhādaliddanāsāya, manorathasamiddhiyā;Kālantaramanāgamma, paccakkhaphaladāyako.
Upanissayavantānaṃ, ‘‘ehi passā’’ti dassiyo;Paccattameva viññūhi, veditabbo sabhāvato.
Sabbāsavasamugghātī, suddho sovatthiko sivo;Pihitāpāyakummaggo, maggo nibbānapattiyā.
Puññatitthamidaṃ nāma, maṅgalañca sivaṅkaraṃ;Hitodayasukhādhāna-mamatāhāramuttamaṃ.
Avijjāpaṭaluddhāravijjānettosadhaṃ varaṃ;Paññādhāramidaṃ satthaṃ, klesagaṇḍappabhedakaṃ.
Caturoghanimuggānaṃ, setubandho samuggato;Bhavacārakaruddhānaṃ, mahādvāro apāruto.
Byasanopaddavāpeto, saṃklesamalanissaṭo;Ujusammattaniyato, paṭipattivisuddhiyā.
Suddhasīlaparikkhāro, samādhimayapañjaro;Sammāsaṅkappacakkaṅgo, sammāvāyāmavāhano.
Vipattipaṭibāhāya, sabbasampattisiddhiyā;Sabbakhandhavimokkhāya, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā.
Hitesī sabbapāṇīnaṃ, dayāpanno mahāmuni;Dhammālokaṃ pakāsesi, cakkhumantānamuttamo.
Bhavayogā vinimuttā, pahīnabhayabheravā;Accantasukhamedhenti, sotthipattā mahesayo.
Pahīnāpāyagamano, pāpaklesavinissaṭo;Paripanthasamucchedī, bhavacārakabhedako.
Uttamadamathappatto, suvinīto mahesinā;Vijjāvimuttivodāto, ājānīyapathe ṭhito.
Sugatorasi sambhūto, sucidhammasirindharo;Paṭipāditasampatto, dhammasāsanasevito.
Bhayabheravanissaṅgo, jinatejānupālito;Moneyyapathasañcāro, sugatovādabhājano.
Ujumaggamadhiṭṭhāya, mārakāyappadālano;Aparājitasaṅgāmo, lalitodātavikkamo.
Maccudheyyamatikkanto, bodhidhammappatiṭṭhito;Chaḷābhiññābalappatto, samārādhitasāsano.
Anubodhimanuppatto, pabhinnapaṭisambhido;Sāmaññapāramippatto, toseti jinamānasaṃ.
Nekākāravarūpeto, nānāsampattiphullito;Vipattipathanittiṇṇo, abhibuddhiparāyaṇo.
Yattha suddhimhi niddose, saddhābījaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ;Accantaṃ paripāceti, sampattiphalamuttam
Ādi cetaṃ patiṭṭhā ca, mukhaṃ pamukhamuttamaṃ;Mūlaṃ kusaladhammānaṃ, pabhavaṃ paṭipattiyā.
Sādhu sikkhāsamādānaṃ, bāhusaccavibhūsanaṃ;Ariyācāracāritta-mavaṇṇamalavajjanaṃ.
Kulaputtaalaṅkāro, pāpajallapavāhanaṃ;Anapāyi sugandhañca, mahāpurisasevitaṃ.
Sopānaṃ saggalokassa, daḷhāpāyavidhānakaṃ;Anupaddavasampatti, samatthaguṇasūdanī.
Klesapañjaravicchedi, vipattipathavāraṇaṃ;Sotthikammasamuṭṭhānaṃ, asādhāraṇamaṅgalaṃ.
‘‘Dullabho vata me laddho,Mahālābho anappako;Yohamakkhalitācāro,Upaghātavivajjito.
‘‘Dhammaṅkuritasantāno, mūlajātosmi sāsane;Ujumaggaṃ samāruḷho, pihitā sabhayā disā.
‘‘Avañcā vata me jāti, āraddhā khaṇasampadā;Patiṭṭhitomhi saddhamme, saphalaṃ mama jīvitaṃ
Saddhāya sīlavantesu, datvā dānaṃ yathārahaṃ;Niddhotamalamacchero, vivitto tamanussare.
Kopadāhopasamanaṃ, maccheramalasodhanaṃ;Pamādaniddāvuṭṭhānaṃ, lobhapāsavimocanaṃ.
Cetovikāradamanaṃ, micchāmagganivāraṇaṃ;Vittilābhasukhassādo, vibhavodayamaṅgalaṃ.
Appamaññāpadaṭṭhānaṃ, appameyyena vaṇṇitaṃ;Mahāpurisacārittaṃ, sapadānaṃ mahesinā.
Dhammādhigatabhogānaṃ, sārādānamanuttaraṃ;Mahattādhigamūpāyaṃ, lokasantatikāraṇaṃ.
Atthakārī ca sammāhaṃ, pariccāgasamāyuto;Attano ca paresañca, hitāya paṭipannakā.
Pihitāpāyamaggosmi, maggadvāramapārutaṃ;Sampattā sabbasampatti, daliddassa manāpikaṃ.
‘‘Saṃsāraddhānapātheyyaṃ, sabbadukkhavinodanaṃ;Subandhaṃ mama sabbattha, gahito ca kaṭagga
Dibbasampattisampattā, nānābhogasamappitā;Pālento dīghamaddhānaṃ, anubhonti mahāsukhaṃ.
Te sabbepi ca mayhampi, vijjanti anupāyino;Saddhādikusalā dhammā, devadhammāti vissutā.
Saddhammaguṇasampatti-dātā maṅgalanāyikā;Dullabhāpi ca me laddhā, saddhā sugatasāsane.
Maccheramalanittiṇṇo, lobhakkhandhavimuccito;Opānabhūto lokasmiṃ, vissaṭṭhasukhayācano.
Samārādhitasaddhammo, katapuññamahussavo;Devadhammasamiddhosmi, kalyāṇacaritākaro.
Devatāhi samānohaṃ, guṇālaṅkārabhūsito;Hatthapattā ca deviddhi, nipphannā dibbasampadā.
Virāgo ca nirodho ca, cāgo mutti anālayo;Yoyamādānanissaggo, nibbānamiti vuccati.
Upasantamidaṃ ṭhānamiti cinteti paṇḍito;Anupādānasaṃkliṭṭhamasaṅkhāramanāsavaṃ.
Appamāṇaṃ paṇītañca, sivaṃ paramamaccutaṃ;Anantaguṇamaccanta-mavikāramanāmayaṃ.
Khemaṃ taṃ pārimatīra-mahāyanakaraṃ paraṃ;Tāṇaṃ leṇañca dīpañca, patiṭṭhānaṃ parāyaṇaṃ.
Sabbapāpavināsoyaṃ, sabbaklesavisodhanaṃ;Sokopāyāsasantāpabhayabheravamocanaṃ.
Paṭipassaddhadaratha-mupacārasamādhinā;Samādhiyati cittañca, parisuddhamanāmayaṃ.
Lokappavatti cintetvā, maraṇānussatiṃ pana;Bhāveyya sakamaccantaṃ, cintento maraṇaṃ kathaṃ
Animittamanaññātaṃ, maccānamidha jīvitaṃ;Kasirañca parittañca, tañca dukkhena saṃyutaṃ.
Appodakamhi maccheva, bandhamāne rudammukhe;Maccu gacchati ādāya, pekkhamāne mahājane.
Purakkhatvāva maraṇaṃ, jāyanti paṭisandhiyaṃ;Jātā puna marissanti, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino.
Yamekarattiṃ paṭhamaṃ, gabbhe vasati mānavo;Abbhuṭṭhitova so yāti, sa gacchaṃ na nivattati
Sattā maranti gabbhepi, jāyamānā ca dārakā;Kumārā yobbanappattā, balappattā mahattarā.
Athāvassaṃ maranteva, jiṇṇā daṇḍaparāyaṇā;Sūrā puññabalatthāmā, nānābyādhinipīḷitā.
Ajja suveti maraṇaṃ, pariyesati pāṇino;Senā yuddhapayātāva, sabbe maccubhayākulā.
Sattāratanalaṅkārā, caturiddhisamuggatā;Cakkavattī mahātejā, rājamaṇḍalasobhino.
Kappuṭṭhānamahāvātā, pātitāva mahāsilā;Patanti maccuvikkhittā, paro cetāna mānavā.
Yepi dīghāyukā devā, vaṇṇavantā mahiddhikā;Ānubhāvabalappattā, mahābhogasukhedhino.
Tepi maccusamuddhattā, bhavanti bhayasaṃkulā;Verambhakkhittapakkhīva, mādisesu kathāva kā.
Accantarāyabahulo, maraṇāhitasambhavo;Niccaṃ cakkasamāruḷho, lokoyaṃ parivattati.
Etthantare maraṇassa, vemajjhe mama vattato;Assāsepi avissaṭṭhe, jīvikā ce kathāva kā.
Accheraṃ vata lokasmiṃ, khaṇamattampi jīvitaṃ;Nissitopaddavaṭṭhāne, mahābyasanapīḷite.
Addhuvaṃ jīvitaṃ nicca-maccantaṃ maraṇaṃ mama;Sabhāvo maraṇanteva, viseso pana jīvitaṃ.
Atthamārabbha gacchanto, ādiccova nabhantare;Maraṇāyābhidhāvanto, vihāyāmi suve suve.
Vajjhappatto mahācoro,Niyyātāghātanaṃ yathā;Maraṇāya payātohaṃ,Tathevamanivattiyo.
Ambujova vaṅkaghasto, tāṇaleṇavivajjito;Niccaṃ maccuvasaṃ yanto, vissaṭṭho kimahaṃ care.
Ko me hāso kimānando,Kimahaṃ mohapāruto;Madappamādavikkhitto,Vicarāmi niraṅkuso?
Handāhamārabhissāmi, sammāsambuddhasāsane;Ātāpī pahitatto ca, hirottappasamāhito.
Itthaṃ panattano yogī, maraṇaṃ paṭicintayaṃ;Maraṇānussatiṃ nāma, bhāvetīti pavuccati.
Micchādhammaṃ virājetvā, nandirāganirālayo;Sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo, pappoti amataṃ padaṃ.
Gahetvā pana medhāvī, dvattiṃsākārabhāvanaṃ;Kareyya tāva pacchā ve, anupubbamabhiṇhaso.

Pubbo ca lohitaṃ sedo,Medo assu vasātha vā;Kheḷo siṅghāṇikā ceva,Lasikā muttamiccapi.
Ghanabandhasubhākāra-vipallāsānusārinaṃ;Yathābhūtāvabodhāya, vibhattāva mahesinā.
Vicittachavisañchannā, tacabhattasamohitā;Parissavaparikliṭṭhā, kuthitā pūtigandhitā.
Dhoviyantāpi satataṃ, ajahantā malassavaṃ;Sugandhānuvilittāpi, duggandhapariṇāmino.

Cakkhusotavatthusaddā, kalāpā cittajāpi ca;Asaññibhūmiyaṃ pubbe, vuttāpi ca na labbhare.
22. Pakiṇṇakakathā
Itthaṃ rūpānamuppattiṃ, dīpetvā dāni vuccati;Pavattikosallatthāya, tatthevetaṃ pakiṇṇakaṃ.
Duvidhā sandhiyo tattha, missāmissavibhāgato;Tividhāpi cekacatu-pañcavokārabhedato.
Rūpamattā asaññīnaṃ, nāmābhāvā amissitā;Nāmamattā arūpīnaṃ, rūpābhāvāti ca dvidhā.
Kāmāvacarikā ceva, rūpāvacarikāti ca;Duvidhā missitā ceti, bhavanti ca catubbidhā.
Ekaccatuvokārā ca, amissā pañca sandhiyo;Chabbīsatividhā missā, pañcavokārasandhiyo.
Aṭṭha santatiyo honti, rūpalokena missitā;Aṭṭhako rāsi tattheko, tasmā santati vuccati.
Iccekakacatukkānaṃ, vasena dve amissitā;Aṭṭhavīsañca missāti, tiṃseva honti sandhiyo.
Ekuppādanirodhā ca, amissā tattha rāsayo;Missitānaṃ vibhāgoyaṃ, yathāyogaṃ kathīyati.
Uppādaṭṭhitibhaṅgānaṃ, vasā tīṇi khaṇānipi;Samānāneva nāmānaṃ, ekacittakkhaṇaṃ mataṃ.
Nāmarūpānamuppādo, bhaṅgopi hi samo mato;Dandhaṃ hi vattikaṃ rūpaṃ, nāmaṃ tu lahuvattikaṃ.
Iccevaṃ catusambhūtā, rūpasantatirāsayo;Rūpāni ca kalāpā ca, ekābaddhā yathārahaṃ.
Suttapavattamattānaṃ, sambuddhānampi pāṇinaṃ;Yāva maraṇakālāpi, pavattanti nirantaraṃ.
Catudhāpi marantassa, tassevaṃ tu yathārahaṃ;Sattarasacittakkhaṇamattasesamhi jīvite.
Tassuppādakkhaṇe jātaṃ,Rūpañca cutiyā saha;Bhijjatīti mato nāma,Tato hoti sa puggalo.
Tato vuttanayeneva, matasatto yathārahaṃ;Missāmissāhi sandhīhi, punadevopapajjati.
Tato vuttanayeneva, ekūnatiṃsa kammajā;Tesamuṭṭhānikā pañca, catuttiṃsa samissitā.
Kalāpā rāsayo honti, sattavīsatibhūmisu;Iti sabbapakārena, rūpadhammā pakāsitāti.
Iti rūpavibhāge pakiṇṇakakathā niṭṭhitā.
